paper_id: Markov process-based retrieval for encrypted JPEG images
title: Markov process-based retrieval for encrypted JPEG images
motivation: Cloud outsourcing of sensitive multimedia requires encryption, but traditional encryption breaks plaintext-based retrieval, creating urgent need for privacy-preserving retrieval on encrypted data.
problem_framing: Achieve image retrieval directly on encrypted JPEG images without decryption, while preserving file size and format compliance, by exploiting DCT coefficient dependencies preserved under specific encryption.
key_insight: Intra-block, inter-block, and inter-component dependencies among DCT coefficients remain statistically invariant under stream cipher + permutation encryption, enabling Markov-based feature extraction from encrypted images.
method_signature: Markov transition probability matrices over DCT VLI code lengths + multi-class SVM dimensionality reduction
evaluation_criteria: Precision-recall curves on Corel database; file size preservation comparison with Zhang [13]
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Intra-block dependency alone yields poor performance because VLI code length replacement conceals actual DCT coefficient values, making little intra-block changes difficult to detect.
evidence_for_taste: the dependencies are similar between similar images
very difficult to identify little changes between neighboring DCT coefficients
not sensitive to little changes between DCT coefficients
performance of the inter-component dependency is worst among all single dependencies
thinking_moves: 从加密后的JPEG文件结构中寻找统计不变量——利用VLI码长度的统计不变性来绕过需要解密的前提
借用隐写分析领域的Markov过程模型来处理DCT系数依赖关系，将其引入加密域检索
用SVM的决策值将高维特征(768维)压缩到类别数维度(w维)，实现监督降维
